title: State of AI — November 2026
content:
![Event artwork for State of AI — November 2026](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/images/classic-events/536571282/676x676.jpg)

About this event

## What to expect

Explore real-world AI applications, emerging trends and responsible development at this online Modern Web (Triangle) meetup on 5 November 2026.

This two-hour **State of AI** session examines how organisations are building, deploying and scaling intelligent systems. AI practitioners and technology leaders from This Dot Labs will discuss what is working today, what may come next and how teams can create smarter, more responsible AI solutions as industry standards evolve.

### Featured speakers

*   [Tracy Lee](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tracyslee/), CEO, This Dot Labs
*   [Elliott Fouts](https://www.linkedin.com/in/elliott-fouts/), President & CTO, This Dot Labs
*   [Rob Ocel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/robocel/), VP of Innovation, This Dot Labs
*   [Brandon Mathis](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mathisbrandon/), Engineering Lead, This Dot Labs
*   [Jonathan Fontanez](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jonathan-fontanez-27715428/), Engineering Lead, This Dot Labs

Hosted by [Modern Web (Triangle)](https://www.meetup.com/trianglemodernweb/), the event is designed for **AI practitioners, product leaders, engineers and innovators** interested in artificial intelligence applications, software development and web technology. It takes place online on **Thursday, 5 November 2026, from 12:30–2:30pm** as displayed on Meetup; the access link is visible to attendees. A detailed talk-by-talk agenda has not been published.

[Register for this online event](https://www.meetup.com/trianglemodernweb/events/316948039)
